about: What the Aside REPL process prints and how it is read (appendix A 9). Each case gives the process result (stdout, stderr, exit code; timed_out when the process did not finish in time) and the expected outcome: envelope (the reassembled {status, url, body}) or error with its kind: invalid (malformed or forbidden output), lost (REPL time limit or lost connection), failed (other nonzero exit), timeout (the process itself exceeded its limit).

cases.name: plain-envelope
cases.fact: The last JSON line is the envelope: status an int in 100-599, url a string, body a string.

cases.name: ansi-and-noise-lines
cases.fact: ANSI colour codes are stripped and only lines starting with { are JSON; an update notice is noise.

cases.name: chunked-body
cases.fact: A large body arrives as body_chunk records (kind, index, body) before an envelope whose body_chunks equals their count; the chunks join in index order.

cases.name: chunk-count-mismatch
cases.fact: body_chunks must equal the number of chunk records.

cases.name: chunk-order-mismatch
cases.fact: Chunk indexes must run 0, 1, 2 ... in order.

cases.name: body-file-refused
cases.fact: An envelope that points at a file instead of carrying the body is refused (no response body is written to disk).

cases.name: two-envelopes
cases.fact: Without body_chunks there is exactly one JSON line.

cases.name: status-out-of-range
cases.fact: status must be an integer from 100 to 599.

cases.name: no-json
cases.fact: No JSON line at all is an invalid response.

cases.name: other-side-closed
cases.fact: A nonzero exit mentioning 'other side closed' is the REPL time limit or a lost connection.

cases.name: daemon-unreachable
cases.fact: A nonzero exit mentioning 'daemon is not reachable' is a lost connection.

cases.name: other-nonzero-exit
cases.fact: Any other nonzero exit is a failed Aside request.
cases.stderr: TypeError: x is not a function

cases.name: process-timeout
cases.fact: The process is given 125 seconds (the REPL itself stops at 120).
